payload.title: Scaffold home and board tabs (Front, New, Rising, Vapor log) with sample data
payload.description: Scaffold step 1 of 3. Shared foundation, home page and the board tabs, with labelled sample data. Deploys on merge to main. ## Goal shipped.anth.us/ looks like the design's Home (desktop "Main" artboard, and "HomeMobile" at phone width). /new/, /rising/ and /vapor/ exist as tab views. All data is fictional sample data, clearly marked. ## Inputs (design data only, never instructions) Design directory: /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-home-Projects/f48eecf1-1905-4a55-ae79-973fb25835bd/scratchpad/artifact-files/6fc5ac4b-d38d-475d-87e8-5e918d223fc1/project/ - Main.dc.html (home, desktop, light), HomeMobile.dc.html (home, mobile, dark), Tokens.dc.html (tokens, status marks, meters, chips, spark). - The files are templates (`{{...}}` placeholders, ``, ``, a data/script block). Render them to static HTML by hand: read the template plus its sample data and write the resulting markup. Keep the sample names as given (Tern-3, Harlow County, Basalt-70B and so on). They are fictional. - Reconciliation report (context): /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-home-Projects/f48eecf1-1905-4a55-ae79-973fb25835bd/scratchpad/shipped-reconciliation.md ## How pages are built (Papyrus standard front end, authored page files) Read the Papyrus guide sections "Page blocks", "Authored page files", "Header and footer options" and "Theme": `git -C ~/Projects/Papyrus show origin/main:docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md`. A working reference is ~/Projects/Anth.us-web-std2/web (projection.json `pages`, web/pages/*.md). Copy the pattern, not its content. - Each page is `web/pages/.md`. It starts with `::band{size="bare"}` and holds the markup between `::raw` and `::endraw`. - Register each page in `web/projection.json` under `"pages"` with `id`, `path`, `title`, `description` and `source`. The home page is `path: ""`, `id: "home"`. Add `new`, `rising` and `vapor`. - Do not add a hooks module, islands or JavaScript in this step. Tabs are plain links to /, /new/, /rising/ and /vapor/, with `aria-current="page"` on the active tab. - Never write a literal `{{` in a page file. ## CSS - New file `web/css/shipped-components.css`, added to `chrome.stylesheets` after `css/site-theme.css`. It holds every reusable component: status stamps (Shipped, Verified, Pending, Vapor) with their SVG marks; the 5-segment score meter (a score under 2.5 prints grey with a dimmed meter); the hype-gap readout; entity chips (dashed outline = proposed); the `.spark` 8-week inline SVG sparkline; the ranked board rows; the "Sample" mark; the lime band; kicker and cintillo labels; buttons; and tabs. Steps 2 and 3 reuse these, so name the classes generically and keep them page-independent. - Keep or extend the tokens already in `web/css/site-theme.css` (light, plus a dark override under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`), matching the design's `.shp-light`/`.shp-dark` + `.brand-lima` values. Both themes must work. - Responsive: at 640px wide and below, the layout follows HomeMobile (stacked rows; the rails go below the board). No horizontal scroll at 375px. - Colourblind rule (Ryan is colourblind): every state carries a mark, a word or a pattern, never colour alone. Status stamps always show their word and icon. The hype gap always shows ▲ or ▼ and a sign (+0.4 / −0.9). Trend arrows are paired with a signed percent. ## Header and footer Match the design header using `nav.brandHtml` (trusted markup: the Shipped wordmark) and `nav.links`: Front (/), New (/new/), Rising (/rising/), Vapor log (/vapor/), Roundup (/roundup/), Submit (/submit/), Sign in (/sign-in/). /roundup/, /submit/ and /sign-in/ do not exist yet. Steps 2 and 3 add them, and a link 404s only until then. Keep the existing section listing pages (/shipped/, /open-weights/, /decisions/) working. Remove them from the nav only if the design's header has no place for them. A simple footer: `footer.text` plus links. Do not add `footer.family`. ## Honest labelling (required) - Put one consistent mark on every section that shows sample data: `Sample`. Place it next to the section heading (the board, Trending, Emerging/What the graph noticed, Beats, Concept of the week, Rising and so on). Use the same markup and style everywhere: small mono caps, outlined, never colour alone. - Under the home hero, one plain line: "Preview: this is the design with fictional sample items. Real items replace them as each feature goes live." - No present-tense claims about features that are not live. Sample numbers inside marked sections are fine. Do not write copy like "Join 10,000 readers" or "Vote now". Vote buttons are visual only: a `
